shots.focal_element: Presenter in a beige knit sweater, tight medium close-up, face slightly left of centre with a branded studio mic and shelf (logo sculpture, books, bust) on the right
shots.what_happens: Hard cut to a tighter angle on the presenter as he pivots to the problem (w59-w72, 'But until now, when it came time to actually do something with those insights'); no graphics, a static locked-off camera, and a dark, low-key set with a shallow-focus background.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a static tighter talking-head clip (face on the left third, mic and shelf in soft focus on the right) for the 'But until now' turn, with no overlays.

shots.focal_element: Wide presenter shot centred-right, with floating white UI cards (article page, search result, translation card) stacking up in the empty left half

shots.typography: Overlay cards use a clean neo-grotesque UI sans (Inter-like, low-confidence guess): a large regular-weight sentence-case headline on the article card, a small semibold site name with a grey URL, a blue medium-weight result title, and small body copy with highlighted phrases. The translation card mixes blue Chinese characters with black English text split by a vertical caret line. 'Profound University' (on the wall screen) and 'Profound' (on the desk sign) are physical set branding, not graphics.
shots.what_happens: The presenter (wide shot) lists the pain points while a matching UI card appears for each one on the left. At w73-w75 ('optimize a page') an article card blurs in, top left. At w76-w79 ('write a meta description') a search-result card blurs in, overlapping it. At w80-w83 ('localize content across markets') a translation card blurs in near the bottom, with text changing from Chinese to English. Around w88-w91 ('Open a separate tool') a cursor grabs a small traffic-light window chrome, which expands into a browser window that encloses all three cards. Around w92-w97 ('stitch it all together yourself') connector lines draw between the cards. Near w98-w100 ('Today, that's changed.') the window fades to translucent.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a static wide presenter clip, blur-in three soft-shadowed white cards (article, SERP result, bilingual text) on the left third, one per spoken task. Then animate a macOS-style window frame that scales up from a cursor-dragged chip to wrap them, draw elbow connector lines between the cards, and fade the window's opacity to about 40% before the cut.

shots.focal_element: Presenter at the desk in the wide studio set, with the 'Profound University' wall screen and the 'Profound' desk sign visible
shots.typography: Set branding only: a bold geometric sans wordmark next to the logo mark, white on the dark wall screen and in raised letters on the desk sign (not added graphics).
shots.what_happens: A brief (about 0.7 s) clean wide shot of the presenter with no overlays, after the semi-transparent window from s007 dissolves away. It acts as a breath after 'Today, that's changed' (w98-w100) before the product demo. The only sample frame looks slightly soft and lower in resolution, so it may sit inside a blur/crossfade.
shots.build_rebuild: Crossfade the overlay window out to a clean wide presenter frame and hold it for about 17 frames, then cross-dissolve with a blur into the product UI.

shots.typography: Native product UI in a small neutral sans (Inter-like, low-confidence guess): medium-weight sentence/title-case node titles, blue pill labels for outputs, grey uppercase-free section headers in the sidebar ('Google Suite', 'Profound Data'), and tiny green 'Succeeded' status tags. There is no added kinetic type.
shots.what_happens: The shot opens heavily blurred and resolves into the full builder window (w101-w104, 'Profound agents let you build'). A node is dragged from the sidebar into the chain. Around 45.5 s the camera punches into the sidebar and canvas, and the cursor scrolls the integrations list from CMS tools through Google Suite to Profound Data (w105-w116, 'AI-powered workflows in the same platform where your data lives'). Around 48.5 s it reframes onto a Run test view where Visibility Score, Sentiment Score and Prompt Volumes nodes tick to 'Succeeded' in sequence, while Article Title Suggestion shows 'Running' and 'Generating output...' (w117-w121, 'Agents that analyze search intent').
shots.build_rebuild: Start a high-fidelity UI recreation of the node canvas at full blur and blur it in to sharp. Animate one node card dragging into the chain, then scale the camera about 1.8x onto the sidebar and scroll the list. Cut to a split view of the node chain and a run log, where each node gets a green 'Succeeded' badge at about 0.5 s stagger and the next shows 'Running'.
